Line numbers¶

The toolkit reads a config file and prints a report.

Note

Every example runs with Python 3.12 or later.

Line numbers drawn inline sit before each line:

1import toolkit
2
3report = toolkit.run("config.toml")

In table style they get a cell of their own:

1
2
for line in report:
    print(line)

Captions¶

config.toml¶
verbose = true

Warning

Keep the file out of version control.

An interactive session keeps its prompts and output:

>>> len(report)
3

Added in version 1.2.
